lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines traverse the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section, with an average lateral interval of approximately 40 pixels, narrowing slightly towards the anterior and posterior edges.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line terminates in the upper third of the torso mass. The ninth, tenth, and eleventh lines exhibit fragmentation, appearing as dashed segments or elongated spots rather than continuous vertical lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 to 8 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior flank and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A series of three distinct white spots align horizontally across the upper-to-mid thigh, forming a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast white patch is visible on the lower throat/chest region, and a distinct white band is present on the lower foreleg above the hoof.
